# Capabilities

Two vocabularies that are not the same thing. A **provider capability** is what a provider must be able to do for a command to work. A **KUANG/11 capability** is what an extension may ask Ono to do, and is a security boundary: granted, scoped, audited and revocable (spec §31.16).

## Provider capabilities

| id | risk | elevation | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `process.list` | read | none | Enumerate processes and their metadata. |
| `process.inspect` | read | conditional | Read the detailed properties of one process, including its open files and cgroup. |
| `process.watch` | observe | none | Subscribe to process appearance, disappearance and metric updates. |
| `process.signal` | mutate | conditional | Deliver a signal to a process. |
| `process.set` | mutate | conditional | Adjust mutable process attributes such as scheduling priority. |
| `process.trace` | read | conditional | Resolve a process's relationships to files, sockets, cgroups and services. |
| `job.list` | read | none | Enumerate the session's jobs. |
| `file.list` | read | conditional | Read file metadata for given paths. |
| `file.find` | read | conditional | Walk a tree and yield matching file metadata. |
| `file.read` | read | conditional | Read file content. |
| `file.write` | mutate | conditional | Create or replace file content. |
| `file.set` | mutate | conditional | Change file metadata — mode, ownership, timestamps. |
| `file.copy` | mutate | conditional | Duplicate a file or tree. |
| `file.move` | mutate | conditional | Relocate a file or tree. |
| `file.remove` | destructive | conditional | Delete a file or tree. |
| `file.watch` | observe | conditional | Subscribe to filesystem change events. |
| `file.open` | mutate | none | Hand a file to its associated handler. |
| `dir.list` | read | conditional | Enumerate the entries of a directory. |
| `service.list` | read | none | Enumerate service-manager units and their states. |
| `service.watch` | observe | none | Subscribe to service state transitions. |
| `service.manage` | mutate | required | Start, stop, restart, enable or disable a service unit. |
| `service.trace` | read | conditional | Resolve a unit's dependency, process, socket and file relationships. |
| `log.read` | read | conditional | Query log or journal records. |
| `socket.list` | read | conditional | Enumerate sockets with their endpoints and states. |
| `socket.watch` | observe | conditional | Subscribe to socket lifecycle events. |
| `socket.close` | destructive | required | Force a socket closed. |
| `socket.trace` | read | conditional | Resolve a socket to its owning process, service and remote endpoint. |
| `connection.list` | read | conditional | Enumerate connection-oriented socket views. |
| `interface.list` | read | none | Enumerate interfaces, addresses and counters. |
| `interface.watch` | observe | none | Subscribe to interface and address changes. |
| `interface.set` | mutate | required | Change interface configuration or administrative state. |
| `route.list` | read | none | Enumerate routing table entries. |
| `route.watch` | observe | none | Subscribe to routing table changes. |
| `route.set` | mutate | required | Add, remove or modify routing table entries. |
| `neighbor.list` | read | none | Enumerate ARP and NDP neighbour entries. |
| `dns.resolve` | read | none | Perform an explicit name resolution. |
| `port.probe` | observe | none | Attempt a connection to a host and port and time the result. |
| `user.list` | read | none | Enumerate user accounts. |
| `user.manage` | mutate | required | Create, remove or modify user accounts. |
| `group.list` | read | none | Enumerate group accounts. |
| `group.manage` | mutate | required | Create, remove or modify group accounts and their membership. |
| `session.list` | read | none | Enumerate login and seat sessions. |
| `env.read` | read | none | Read environment and shell variables. |
| `env.set` | mutate | none | Set an environment or shell variable in the current scope. |
| `mount.list` | read | none | Enumerate mounted filesystems with their structured options. |
| `mount.watch` | observe | none | Subscribe to mount and unmount events. |
| `mount.manage` | mutate | required | Mount, unmount or remount a filesystem. |
| `filesystem.list` | read | conditional | Enumerate filesystems and their capacity, mounted or not. |
| `device.list` | read | none | Enumerate block and character devices. |
| `package.list` | read | none | Enumerate installed and known packages. |
| `package.search` | read | none | Search the provider's repositories. |
| `package.manage` | mutate | required | Install, remove or transition the version of a package. |
| `package-source.list` | read | none | Enumerate the repositories the package manager reads its index from. |
| `package-source.refresh` | mutate | required | Bring the local package index up to date from a repository. |
| `container.list` | read | conditional | Enumerate containers through an installed container provider. |
| `container.manage` | mutate | conditional | Start, stop, restart, remove or reconfigure a container. |
| `container.exec` | mutate | conditional | Execute inside a container's namespaces. |
| `container.trace` | read | conditional | Resolve a container's namespaces, cgroups, mounts, processes and image. |
| `image.list` | read | conditional | Enumerate container or machine images. |
| `host.list` | read | none | Enumerate known hosts from configured sources. |
| `host.probe` | observe | none | Check a host's reachability and advertised capabilities. |
| `host.trust` | mutate | none | Record, replace or forget a pinned host key (spec §21.5, ADR-0015 T5/T6). |
| `link.create` | mutate | none | Establish a remote Ono link, performing the handshake of spec §21.2. |
| `link.list` | read | none | Enumerate active links. |
| `link.watch` | observe | none | Subscribe to link state and health changes. |
| `link.manage` | mutate | none | Create, modify, detach or remove a link definition. |
| `plugin.list` | read | none | Enumerate installed and loaded KUANG/11 packages and their runtime health. |
| `plugin.search` | read | none | Search configured extension sources without executing any package. |
| `plugin.inspect` | read | none | Read a package's manifest, origin, contributions, capabilities and errors. |
| `plugin.verify` | read | none | Validate a package's integrity, signature and contract compatibility. |
| `plugin.install` | mutate | none | Verify and install a package into the managed store. |
| `plugin.remove` | destructive | none | Remove an installed package. |
| `plugin.load` | mutate | none | Negotiate capabilities and instantiate a package's runtime. |
| `plugin.unload` | mutate | none | Drain a package's jobs and withdraw its runtime contributions. |
| `plugin.set` | mutate | none | Change a package's management settings, such as enablement and background policy. |
| `capability.list` | read | none | Read capability definitions, requests, grants and leases. |
| `capability.grant` | mutate | none | Create a scoped capability grant or lease, subject to policy. |
| `capability.revoke` | mutate | none | Revoke a capability grant or lease. |
| `assistant.list` | read | none | Enumerate loaded assistant extensions. |
| `assistant.ask` | mutate | none | Run an assistant turn under an explicit context and model policy. |
| `model.list` | read | none | Enumerate configured model providers and their policy characteristics. |
| `finding.list` | read | none | Query findings emitted by analyses and assistants. |
| `audit.list` | read | none | Query the record of capability-sensitive KUANG/11 actions. |
| `config.read` | read | none | Read resolved configuration settings with their provenance. |
| `config.set` | mutate | none | Change a configuration setting in the current scope. |
| `command.list` | read | none | Enumerate native and external commands and their metadata. |

## KUANG/11 capabilities

| id | risk | elevation | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object.read` | read | none | Read objects from the host's object world. |
| `schema.read` | read | none | Read schema definitions and their field metadata. |
| `process.read` | read | none | Read process objects. |
| `process.signal` | mutate | conditional | Deliver signals to processes. |
| `process.exec` | mutate | conditional | Execute an external program. |
| `filesystem.read` | read | conditional | Read files and directories. |
| `filesystem.write` | destructive | conditional | Create, modify or delete files. |
| `filesystem.watch` | observe | conditional | Subscribe to filesystem change events. |
| `network.observe` | read | conditional | Observe network state — sockets, interfaces, routes, neighbours. |
| `network.connect` | mutate | none | Open outbound network connections. |
| `network.listen` | mutate | conditional | Bind and accept inbound connections. |
| `service.read` | read | none | Read service-manager units and their state. |
| `service.mutate` | mutate | required | Change the state of service-manager units. |
| `container.read` | read | conditional | Read container objects. |
| `container.exec` | mutate | conditional | Execute inside a container. |
| `remote.read` | read | none | Read objects across a remote link. |
| `remote.mutate` | mutate | conditional | Perform mutations across a remote link. |
| `history.read` | read | none | Read the session's semantic history. |
| `history.write` | mutate | none | Add entries to the session's history. |
| `context.read` | read | none | Read the current context stack — cwd, active object, active link. |
| `ui.view` | read | none | Contribute a view or TUI lens and render into it. |
| `ui.notify` | mutate | none | Raise a notification to the operator. |
| `relation.read` | read | none | Read relationship edges from the graph. |
| `relation.write` | mutate | none | Contribute relationship edges to the graph. |
| `secret.use` | mutate | none | Use a secret without reading its value. Spec §17.5 and §31.20 keep the value redacted; the capability grants use, not disclosure. |
| `model.infer` | mutate | none | Send a request to a model provider through the model broker (spec §31.43). |
| `plugin.invoke` | mutate | none | Invoke a contribution of another loaded package (spec §31.30). |
| `state.persist` | mutate | none | Store extension state across sessions (spec §31.31). |
| `clock.read` | read | none | Read the wall clock. |
